news.title: Bompastor updates on Lexi Potter ahead of Charlton
news.title_zh: 博姆帕斯特在查尔顿之前更新了莱克西·波特的情况
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor was pleased to confirm Lexi Potter’s knee injury is not serious, and while the midfielder will likely miss the game against Charlton, our head coach hopes to have her back before too long. The Blues face yet another London derby this weekend, this time against newly-promoted Charlton at The Valley. We sit at the top of the WSL table after seven games, equal on points with Manchester City on 19, but with a superior goal difference. We come into the game off the back of the midweek European victory against Roma. The only disappointment on the night was an injury picked up by Potter late on, but Bompastor reported it is not as bad as it could have been. ‘Lexi did an MRI yesterday evening and nothing major from her knee, so it’s good news,’ said the head coach at her media conference at Cobham. ‘She probably won’t be available for this weekend. We just need things to settle down a little bit, but nothing major. ‘We will see how she improves next week, and if she can be available for the Everton game.’ So far this season Bompastor has benefitted from having a largely fit squad to pick from, in contrast to the 2025/26 campaign. Managing players’ loads is of course a crucial component of her management, and she explained why the quality on display in the Women’s Super League and the Champions League makes finding that balance difficult. ‘You can’t really have the mindset to rotate your team in the league, even when sometimes you’ve played in the Champions League in midweek,’ she explained. ‘The level of both competitions doesn’t always give you that opportunity. In France you could easily play in the league with a really young team against some teams and you will still get a result. ‘Here it’s about making sure the recovery between the games is appropriate and as efficient as possible, because the players need to perform at a really good level every three days. When you play for a club like Chelsea that’s what happens. She added: ‘The players need to be robust, but as a manager you need to find opportunities to sometimes give them that rest, mental and physical rest, because they are not machines – maybe Lucy Bronze is the only one! ‘But they need some break. Off the back of this summer, the players didn’t have a big tournament, and certainly here at Chelsea availability has been a lot better than in past years.’
news.body_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯托很高兴地确认莱克西·波特的膝盖伤势并不严重，虽然这位中场球员可能会缺席对阵查尔顿的比赛，但我们的主教练希望她很快就能回归。本周末，蓝军将迎来另一场伦敦德比，这次是在山谷球场对阵升班马查尔顿。七场比赛过后，我们在 WSL 积分榜上位居榜首，积分与第 19 场的曼城持平，但净胜球优势更大。我们在周中欧战战胜罗马后进入比赛。当晚唯一令人失望的是波特在晚些时候受伤，但邦帕斯特报告说情况并没有想象的那么严重。 “莱克西昨天晚上做了核磁共振检查，膝盖没有什么大问题，所以这是个好消息，”主教练在科巴姆举行的媒体发布会上说。 “她这个周末可能没空。我们只是需要让事情安定下来，但没什么大不了的。 “我们将看看她下周的进步情况，以及她是否可以参加埃弗顿的比赛。”与2025/26赛季相比，本赛季到目前为止，邦帕斯托受益于拥有一支基本健康的阵容可供选择。管理球员的负荷当然是她管理的一个重要组成部分，她解释了为什么女足超级联赛和冠军联赛中所表现出的质量使得找到这种平衡变得困难。 “你不可能真正有在联赛中轮换球队的心态，即使有时你在周中参加了冠军联赛，”她解释道。 “两项比赛的水平并不总是能给你这样的机会。在法国，你可以很容易地在联赛中与一支非常年轻的球队对阵一些球队，但你仍然会得到结果。 “这里的重点是确保比赛之间的恢复适当且尽可能高效，因为球员需要每三天发挥出非常好的水平。当你为切尔西这样的俱乐部效力时，就会发生这种情况。她补充道：“球员们需要坚强，但作为一名主教练，你需要找到机会让他们有时得到休息，精神和身体上的休息，因为他们不是机器——也许露西·青铜是唯一的机器！” “但他们需要休息一下。今年夏天结束后，球员们没有参加大型比赛，当然切尔西的可用性比过去几年要好得多。

news.title: Xabi Alonso on ‘important’ Wesley Fofana and his centre-back options
news.title_zh: 哈维·阿隆索谈“重要”韦斯利·福法纳和他的中后卫选择
news.body_en: Maxence Lacroix has featured in every Chelsea game since joining from Crystal Palace this summer, but that run will end when we take on Manchester United. The defender’s absence leaves Xabi Alonso with a decision to make. Lacroix limped off at Anfield on Wednesday night, with Alonso confirming after the game that the France international had sustained a hamstring injury. At his pre-match media conference this afternoon, Alonso added that we are unlikely to see Lacroix in a Chelsea shirt again until after next month’s international break. Having started all but one Premier League fixture this term and our three Carabao Cup ties in the heart of defence, Lacroix’s unavailability leaves a hole that needs filling. Wesley Fofana is one defender Alonso can turn to, with Lacroix’s compatriot having played the full 90 minutes at Anfield. Although his penalty miss ultimately proved pivotal in the shootout, Alonso says Fofana performed well and is one of several defensive options that could be used against United. ‘With Max's injury, we have Wes, we have Levi [Colwill], Josh [Acheampong] could play as well as a centre-back, Jorrel [Hato] when he’s back with the team [after injury],’ explained Alonso. ‘For sure Wes has played, and even if he missed the penalty, I think that he had a good game. He was consistent, he was strong, and I saw many positives from his performance. ‘We know the level that he has had, and he's going to be important.’ Don't miss out! General admission tickets are sold out, so the only way to watch Chelsea vs Man Utd at Stamford Bridge is with a Chelsea hospitality package. A limited number of packages remain. Book hospitality now.
news.body_zh: 自从今年夏天从水晶宫加盟以来，马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦在切尔西的每场比赛中都有出场，但当我们对阵曼联时，这种表现就会结束。后卫的缺席让哈维·阿隆索需要做出决定。周三晚上，拉克鲁瓦在安菲尔德一瘸一拐地下场，阿隆索赛后证实这位法国国脚腿筋受伤。在今天下午的赛前媒体发布会上，阿隆索补充说，在下个月的国际比赛日结束之前，我们不太可能再次看到拉克鲁瓦身披切尔西球衣。本赛季除了一场英超比赛之外，我们在后防线上的三场卡拉宝杯比赛中都首发出场，拉克鲁瓦的缺席留下了一个需要填补的漏洞。韦斯利·福法纳是阿隆索可以求助的后卫之一，拉克鲁瓦的同胞已经在安菲尔德踢满了 90 分钟。尽管他的点球失误最终在点球大战中发挥了关键作用，但阿隆索表示福法纳表现出色，是可以用来对抗曼联的几个防守选择之一。阿隆索解释道，“由于马克斯受伤，我们有韦斯、列维（科尔威尔）、约什（阿切姆蓬），当他（受伤后）回归球队时，乔什（阿切姆蓬）可以打得和中后卫一样好。” “毫无疑问，韦斯参加了比赛，即使他罚丢了点球，我认为他打了一场精彩的比赛。他很稳定，很坚强，我从他的表现中看到了很多积极的一面。 “我们知道他已经达到的水平，他将会变得很重要。”不要错过！普通门票已售完，因此观看切尔西在斯坦福桥对阵曼联的唯一方式就是购买切尔西招待套餐。剩余数量有限。立即预订招待。

news.title: Xabi Alonso confirms Chelsea team news for Manchester United
news.title_zh: 哈维·阿隆索确认了切尔西队为曼联效力的消息
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso does not expect Maxence Lacroix to return to action before the international break due to a hamstring issue, but Moises Caicedo is available for selection against Manchester United. After midweek heartache in the Carabao Cup, which saw us exit the competition after a penalty shootout defeat to Liverpool, the Blues’ focus has switched back to the Premier League. Our opening eight top-flight fixtures have yielded 13 points and put us fifth in the early-season table. United, in contrast, sit 16th having won just once thus far in the league. Alonso will be forced into changes against the Red Devils, one of which will be deciding who replaces Lacroix after the centre-back came off during Wednesday’s game at Anfield. ‘Max picked up an injury and we expect that he will not be ready before the international break,’ the Blues manager explained in his pre-match press conference. ‘So he will be a few weeks out.’ Alonso also confirmed that Jorrel Hato will be absent against United. ‘How long, we don't know, but he’s not available for tomorrow. He has a back problem and he's not feeling okay for tomorrow.’ Pep Chavarria is in contention after missing our last three matches, and Caicedo is also available despite coming off in the second half against Liverpool. ‘No issue', replied Alonso when asked about the Ecuadorian. ‘He is ok for tomorrow.’ There was also an update provided on Argentine duo Aaron Anselmino, who has yet to feature this season, and Emi Martinez. On Anselmino, Alonso said: ‘He is not available yet. He has had a few things, a few injuries, and it will take a few weeks until he is fully fit. We need to be cautious with him as he's had a few of them, so he is still not there.' Martinez has been sidelined since our victory at Everton, after which he required jaw surgery following a clash with Jarrad Branthwaite. But Alonso believes it is possible the 34-year-old will be available before the international break. ‘Yes, there is a chance,' he said. 'We need to still wait for next week, but let’s see how things go. But there is a chance.’ Don't miss out! news.title: Kobe Barbour signs new deal
news.title_zh: 科比·巴伯签下新合同
news.body_en: Chelsea Football Club is pleased to announce that Cobham Next Gen’s Kobe Barbour has signed a new contract, keeping him at the club until at least June 2030. Since joining the Blues as an Under-8, Barbour has steadily progressed through the youth ranks. He was also part of the sides which won the Under-16 Premier League and Under-17 Premier League Cup in 2024. The attacking midfielder, who can play both centrally and out wide, scored five goals and provided two assists in 2025/26 for the Under-18s. He made five league appearances for CNG in the same campaign and marked his UEFA Youth League debut with a goal in our 5-2 victory over Benfica.
news.body_zh: 切尔西足球俱乐部很高兴地宣布科巴姆下一代球员科比·巴伯 (Kobe Barbour) 签署了一份新合同，他将在俱乐部效力至少到 2030 年 6 月。自从作为 8 岁以下球员加入蓝军以来，巴伯在青年队中稳步进步。他还是2024年赢得U-16英超联赛和U-17英超联赛杯冠军的球队成员之一。这位攻击型中场可以踢中路和边路，在2025/26赛季为U-18队打进5球并贡献2次助攻。同一赛季，他为 CNG 联赛出场五次，并在我们 5-2 战胜本菲卡的比赛中打进一球，这是他在青年联赛中的处子秀。

news.title: Levi Colwill: We’re learning with every day and every game
news.title_zh: 列维·科尔威尔：我们每天、每场比赛都在学习
news.body_en: Levi Colwill believes he and his fellow Chelsea players are developing and improving as a team every time they step out onto the pitch, and he is excited by the chance to show it in our upcoming matches. Results have been mixed since the last international break, with back-to-back Premier League victories over Bournemouth and Everton followed by a loss to Tottenham Hotspur and Wednesday’s narrow Carabao Cup exit on penalties at Liverpool. However, Colwill underlined that this Blues side is still learning under manager Xabi Alonso and taking every opportunity to gel and improve. ‘Every day we're learning and we're coming closer together as a team,’ said the defender. ‘I think we take something from each performance, win or lose. ‘We're really starting to become a unit and believe and want to fight for each other. I think this season, when we go into really good form, we can try and push up the league as much as we can, and hopefully win a competition in there too. But we've got some really big games coming up and we're excited for them.’ The next of those games arrives in Saturday’s early kick-off, when Chelsea host Manchester United at Stamford Bridge in the Premier League. Ahead of that fixture, Colwill pointed out that the learning process is not just for the team, explaining how as a player at the highest level you never stop developing as an individual either. ‘I feel like you always learn things when you play; every season I learn something new,’ he said, before sharing the most important lesson he has gleaned as a footballer. ‘Probably for me, compared to when I first started, making my debut, it'd probably just be to try and meet the team and be a big character. When I was younger, it's a lot harder and I know I was much quieter than I am now. ‘I like to try and talk as much as possible, give them as much confidence as possible. So probably just be a leader and speak that bit further.’ Another source of confidence is Alonso’s presence in the dugout. The footballing ability our manager still shows on the training pitch demands the respect of his players, while Colwill was impressed by our manager right from their first conversation in the summer. ‘His technique that he shows every day on the football pitch is insane. He could still be playing out there somewhere,’ added Levi. ‘So when you're doing sessions with him and he can make a pass that the majority of players out there can't do, it really humbles you a bit. ‘My first conversation with him was in pre-season. It was just a get-to-know-him conversation, to know a little about him. ‘Of course, he would've heard a little bit about me from the other coaches and players maybe. But it was a really chill conversation. It gave me a lot of confidence and I was really excited to get to work with him, and I have been really happy working with him.’
news.body_zh: 列维·科尔威尔相信，他和他的切尔西队友每次踏上球场时，都在作为一个团队不断发展和进步，他很高兴有机会在我们即将举行的比赛中展示这一点。自上次国际比赛日以来，结果好坏参半，英超联赛连续战胜伯恩茅斯和埃弗顿，随后输给托特纳姆热刺，周三在卡拉宝杯点球大战中险些出局。然而，科尔威尔强调，这支蓝军仍在主教练哈维·阿隆索的带领下学习，并抓住一切机会凝聚和提高。 “我们每天都在学习，作为一个团队，我们的距离越来越近，”这名后卫说道。 “我认为我们从每场比赛中都能学到一些东西，无论输赢。 “我们真的开始成为一个整体，相信并希望为彼此而战。我认为这个赛季，当我们进入真正良好的状态时，我们可以尝试尽可能地提升联赛排名，并希望也能赢得那里的比赛。但我们即将迎来一些非常重要的比赛，我们为它们感到兴奋。”下一场比赛将于周六提前开赛，届时切尔西将在英超联赛的斯坦福桥迎战曼联。在那场比赛之前，科尔威尔指出，学习过程不仅仅是为了球队，他解释了作为一名最高水平的球员，你也永远不会停止个人的发展。 “我觉得你在玩耍时总是能学到东西；每个赛季我都会学到一些新东西，”他在分享他作为一名足球运动员学到的最重要的教训之前说道。 “对我来说，与我刚开始首次亮相时相比，可能只是尝试与团队见面并成为一个大人物。当我年轻的时候，这要困难得多，我知道我比现在安静得多。 “我喜欢尝试尽可能多地交谈，给他们尽可能多的信心。因此，可能只是成为一名领导者并进一步发言。”另一个信心来源是阿隆索在教练席上的表现。我们的主教练在训练场上仍然展现出的足球能力需要他的球员们的尊重，而科尔威尔从夏天的第一次谈话就对我们的主教练印象深刻。 “他每天在足球场上展示的技术是疯狂的。他可能还在某个地方打球，”利维补充道。 “所以当你和他一起训练时，他能传出大多数球员都做不到的传球，这真的会让你感到有点谦卑。 “我和他的第一次谈话是在季前赛期间。这只是一次了解他的谈话，了解一些关于他的事情。 “当然，他也许会从其他教练和球员那里听说过一些关于我的事情。但这是一次非常冷静的谈话。这给了我很大的信心，我很高兴能和他一起工作，而且我很高兴与他一起工作。”
